sentence: Ouinergy fades. Don't be rizzappointed by the door you ran toward.

wombos.definition: The electrifying, excited energy that rushes through you when an attractive person walks into the room. Often a shared experience — two people can be ouinergistic simultaneously.
wombos.example: The second she walked in, I felt pure ouinergy.

wombos.definition: Let down by someone's rizz — disappointment that lands specifically because the charm-game was weaker than advertised.
wombos.example: You d'aven't held your own — I'm really rizzappointed.
